questions.q: 110. Free hand sketch is generally used to represent
questions.explain: Freehand sketches are valued for their speed, used primarily to quickly capture and communicate a concept or idea before formal drafting.

questions.q: 111. The main purpose of free hand drawing is
options: to quickly convey an idea without instruments
questions.explain: Freehand drawing allows an engineer or designer to communicate ideas rapidly without relying on precision instruments.

questions.q: 112. In engineering field, free hand drawing is generally used for
questions.explain: Engineers commonly use freehand sketches for preliminary design discussions, site notes, and quick conceptual studies.

questions.q: 113. The technique to draw a freehand straight line is to
options: look at the point where the line is to end
move the pencil slowly with wrist locked
use a straight edge for guidance
questions.explain: A common freehand sketching technique is to focus the eyes on the endpoint of the intended line rather than watching the moving pencil tip.

questions.q: 114. The technique to draw a freehand circle is to
options: mark the centre and radius points first, then join freehand
questions.explain: A common technique is to lightly mark the center and a few key points along the desired radius, then sketch the curve freehand connecting these guide points.

options: drawing made with the aid of drafting instruments
drawing made without the aid of drafting instruments/mechanical devices
questions.explain: By definition, freehand sketching involves creating a drawing purely by hand, without rulers, compasses, or other mechanical aids.

questions.q: 138. Freehand sketching requires the drafter to have
options: a high degree of manual proficiency
questions.explain: Since no instruments are used, freehand sketching relies heavily on the manual skill and practiced hand-eye coordination of the drafter.

questions.q: 139. Sketching of an object without using any instrument is called
questions.explain: Freehand sketching is specifically defined as drawing done entirely by hand without the aid of drafting instruments.

options: intended as a finished, dimensioned product
not intended as a finished, dimensioned product
questions.explain: Sketches serve as preliminary communication tools and are typically not treated as final, precisely dimensioned deliverables.

questions.q: 160. A drawing which is fully rendered with shades and shadow, colour or wash to give a realistic effect is known as
questions.explain: Presentation drawings are pictorial/rendered drawings enhanced with shading, color, and texture, designed for clients rather than fabrication.

questions.q: 175. *Free hand drawing of an ordinary room, using two point perspective, would show :
options: two walls meeting at a corner, both receding to vanishing points
three walls with no vanishing points
questions.explain: In two-point perspective, an interior corner view of a room typically shows two walls converging visually toward two separate vanishing points on the horizon.
